remarks:
Welcome to 79 Kenview Avenue! Pride of ownership is evident throughout this meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath Cape Cod in the Town of Tonawanda. A comfortable and versatile floor plan offers two bedrooms and a full bath on the first floor, providing the convenience of one-floor living when desired. The bright living room offers generous space for relaxing and entertaining, while the fully appliance kitchen includes an adjoining dining area for everyday meals.

Upstairs, you'll discover more than simply a third bedroom. A spacious bedroom, sitting area and half bath create a flexible second-floor retreat that could work equally well as a private primary suite, guest space or home office combination.

The full basement adds even more possibilities, with a partially finished area providing valuable additional recreational or hobby space along with storage. Washer Dryer included. Outside, a manageable yard and patio alongside the detached one-car garage offer a comfortable spot for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing.

Central air adds summertime comfort, while the home's convenient Town of Tonawanda location provides easy access to shopping, restaurants, recreation and the surrounding Northtowns. 

Lovingly cared for and ready for its next chapter, 79 Kenview Avenue offers the space, flexibility and pride of ownership buyers have been waiting for.
